ready_invariant: all active target watermarks cover source; no omissions, conflicts or fallback
lagging_behavior: read canonical scoped turns as raw fallback and expose omitted ranges
degraded_behavior: preserve raw fallback, expose backend reason codes, never report failure as NO_MATCH
unavailable_behavior: stop before inference when neither source watermarks nor raw context can be trusted
current_turn: excluded from raw fallback by request_id because it is supplied separately to the model
cross_session_retrieval: on-demand ServiceEpisodeRetriever owned by Planner/Agent tool
